name: D.E.V -Shintaku no Hime to Akage no Kishi-
original_name: D.E.V-神託の姫と赤毛の騎士-
source:
The road of the pilgrimage to the temple is long and hard. It is a path of hardships that must be overcome in order to complete the journey. Now, for the first time in a hundred years, two people undertake this pilgrimage. They are princess Medi and a red-haired knight called Ann.
But the journey is full of inhumane, tragic trials that exceed their worst expectations.

The traps for the oracle princess are many. They are designed to prepare her for impregnation with a demon lord. Will Medi succeed in overcoming the minutely planned out traps?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ031507.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
去寺庙朝圣的路是漫长而艰辛的。这是一条必须克服困难才能完成旅程的道路。现在，一百年来第一次有两个人进行这次朝圣。他们是公主梅迪和红发骑士安。
但这段旅程充满了非人道、悲惨的考验，超出了他们最坏的预期。

神谕公主的陷阱有很多。它们的目的是让她为恶魔领主的怀孕做好准备。梅迪能否成功突破精心策划的陷阱呢？
